source_title: MEDKids Teeth starter card (demonstration data, unreviewed)
primary_objective: Understand what teeth do and how to keep them healthy
educational_content: Teeth help us bite and chew food. Children have 20 baby teeth. Baby teeth fall out and grown-up teeth grow in. Brushing teeth twice a day helps keep them healthy. Too much sugar can cause holes in teeth called cavities.
learning_objectives: Teeth help us bite and chew food.
Baby teeth fall out and grown-up teeth grow in.
Brushing twice a day keeps teeth healthy.
Too much sugar can cause cavities.

forbidden_claims.claim: Grown-up teeth grow back if lost
